newsitem.title: USA: El Paso Energy unit sets Virginia expansion.
newsitem.headline: El Paso Energy unit sets Virginia expansion.

text.p: East Tennessee Natural Gas Co said Thursday it has proposed an expansion of its Virginia facilities.

Although a separate project, the Virginia Expansion Project complements the East Tennessee expansion the El Paso Energy Corp business unit announced in August 1996 for customers in eastern Tennessee, the company said.

The open season for the Virginia Expansion Project started Wednesday and continues through June 23. The addition to system capacity and cost of the project will be based on the open season results, East Tennessee said, adding the proposed in service date is November 1, 1998.
